messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> P0: az5 serving degradation (route evictions) for inference-runtime
oncall-alex: got the page, looking now
pagerduty-bot: PD INCIDENT INC-31415 triggered, page sent to SRE rotation
sre-jordan: acked on PD, joining thread
oncall-alex: quick summary from logs: spikes in KV cache evictions across az5 hosts, consistent 503s from runtime
eng-runtime-lee: pulling metrics — cache_miss_rate ~ 86% over last 2m, qps stable but tail latency rising; linking logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/az5/evictions
infra-sam: control-plane autoscaler in az5 showing a bunch of 429s when we try to scale pods (api rate limit)
sre-jordan: plan proposal: divert new incoming traffic off az5 to az3/az4 routing fallback, enable emergency burst nodes in az2 as backup. thoughts?
customer-success-maya: CS note: two high-touch customers reporting timeouts and elevated latency, tickets opened — flagging potential SLA impact
oncall-alex: executing routing divert to reduce hit on az5. we'll keep az5 read-only for draining
eng-runtime-lee: running divert command now:
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/routing/divert -d '{"from":"az5","to":["az3","az4"],"percent":80}'
```
oncall-alex: divert command issued, waiting for propagation (~30s)
incident-bot: routing-divert job started (job id rd-7890)
oncall-alex: also enabling fallback model variant on az3 (quantized) to absorb higher QPS while we stabilize az5
eng-runtime-lee: kicking off quick rollout to fallback model:
```
redwoodctl rollout --cluster az3 --model rdl-3-small-quant --percent 100
```
infra-sam: provisioning burst pool in az2 (4 gpus requested), ETA ~2m
pagerduty-bot: PD escalation rule: escalation to L2 in 5m if not stabilized
sre-jordan: L2: @eng-runtime-lee on call, thanks — monitoring rebalancing metrics
oncall-alex: metrics update: 503 rate down from 18% -> 4% over 3m, p95 latency down from 320ms -> 120ms. progress but not fully healed
customer-success-maya: sending quick customer update: "We’re mitigating a regional serving issue; traffic being rerouted. We’ll follow up in 15m with more details."
eng-runtime-lee: still seeing sporadic kv misses tied to one host (az5-host-72) — looks like an OOM / cache fragmentation pattern on that instance
infra-sam: cordoning az5-host-72 and draining; job started to rehome shards
sre-jordan: confirming cordon/drain — continuing to monitor error budgets
oncall-alex: keeping PD acknowledged — we'll hold until az5 error rate <1% and stable for 10m
pagerduty-bot: PD status updated: acknowledged, assigned to SRE rotation; escalation suspended
oncall-alex: quick root-cause hypothesis for postmortem: KV cache fragmentation + autoscaler API rate-limiting prevented rapid replacement, led to sustained evictions
customer-success-maya: I'll follow up with affected customers in 30m with detailed status and next steps
incident-bot: Automated monitoring will keep this incident open for 2 hours for regression checks; replay alerts enabled
oncall-alex: prepping handoff notes to night team in 1h if stable — will include commands used and links to dashboards :thumbsup:
---
(oncall-alex)
